evidence: Pass is limited to the workbook row's plausibility bar, not a measured Oracle score. All 79 Functional descriptions were walked against their protocols, reference source and source-bound observations. Reference app.tsx:16-18,53-74,95-104,126-169 implements inspectable console values, examples, exact save/load and dirty-conflict handling, editor/language/theme controls and labelled responsive surfaces; server.js:41-88,113-129 implements trimmed case-sensitive titles, current-revision writes and SQLite durability; runtime.ts:24-66,130-269,299-386 implements source-line mapping, supported literal execution, deadlines, current-preview lifecycle and rollback. The current golden raw run records 79 fresh Functional fact keys, no missing/failed keys, both gates and six Polish checks; all 102 current_golden artifact hashes, the exact 79-criterion mapping, all recorded installed app bytes and frozen solution/prompt/context bindings matched current frozen bytes. This is actual scripted product evidence, not configured judge output. Concrete observations include post-results S03 late-interaction-failure at entered line 5 with interaction-latest-good restored; S04 separately completed JS/HTML/CSS replacements after a working four-second A callback and no late takeover; S09 finite controls 3/4/3 followed by roughly 4.9-second loop timeouts; S10-S13 errors at JS line 4, HTML line 6, timer JS/HTML lines 2/6 and rejection JS/HTML lines 2/6 with retained good previews; S23 both editor-role trials returned current-record-preserving 409 conflicts while retaining exact dirty fields and permitting reapplication. S22 records complete saved-record and five-example inventory readbacks across the actual single MCP restart; the row does not infer durability from source alone. Surface raw evidence records actual authored execution, independent clean-context save/read, named controls, keyboard example/saved-record navigation, visible focus, and mobile edit/Run/Clear use. I inspected both original desktop theme images and the mobile image against all six Visual anchors: the chrome has legible contrasting type, coherent pane grouping and conventional stacked mobile adaptation, supporting plausible high visual credit without assigning a grade. Original desktop-theme-two.png and mobile.png omit preview text despite DOM readback. A specifically authorized fresh offline diagnostic against the same pinned image and frozen app produced visible Preview ready content in light-viewport.png/light-frame.png and mobile-frame.png. Its mobile-full.png omits the offscreen preview while the direct frame capture after scrolling shows it, with unchanged visible text/styles and positive bounds: capture omission is demonstrated for that reproduced mobile case only. The earlier desktop omission was not reproduced in fresh state and its cause remains unresolved; the diagnostic does not establish a universal explanation for prior captures. All 21 new command/source/image/raw artifacts are hash-indexed under current_row18_visual_diagnostic; original evidence was preserved. Adversarial reading: a dead-timer implementation could appear to suppress late effects, but S04 and S36 require matching actually working callbacks; a blanket-rejecting save implementation lacks S23/S24 successful write controls. A conforming static rollback picture remains valid under Functional prompt:17,159-171 and runtime.ts:358-364; a conforming stacked or tabbed mobile layout is accepted by Polish responsive_layout and Visual responsive anchors. No criterion the reference demonstrably cannot satisfy was found. Risk remains true because the configured Oracle/full judge and visual grades are unmeasured, and the original desktop capture discrepancy is not fully explained. The 142.922-second scripted host run and 5.531-second focused diagnostic are not configured judge workload measurements or hosted acceptance evidence.
